03/12/2026 Tentative Ruling

Motion to Compel Further Responses to Requests for Production

Hearing Date: March 13, 2026

Department: C-60

Judge: Honorable Matthew C. Braner

 

Plaintiffs Sumayya Aasi and Mohammad Aasi move to compel further responses to Requests for Production, Set One, Nos. 15-28 from Defendant American Honda Motor Co Inc.

 

The Court has reviewed the moving papers, opposition, and reply. The motion is GRANTED IN PART AND DENIED IN PART.

 

The motion is GRANTED as to Requests Nos. 15-22. Defendant shall provide further responses within 20 days of notice of this ruling.

The motion is DENIED as to Requests Nos. 23-28 as the requests are overbroad and unduly burdensome.

 

Sanctions are DENIED. The Court finds both parties acted with substantial justification.
